mapper.select: SELECT * FROM medical_documents ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_documents SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, specialty = #{specialty}, keywords = #{keywords}, author = #{author}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, source = #{source}, vector_id = #{vectorId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT *, MATCH(title, content, keywords) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) as relevance FROM medical_documents WHERE MATCH(title, content, keywords) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY relevance DESC LIMIT 20
